notes: The nominated span is a Statement of Basis cover title identifying the document as concerning a draft NPDES permit to discharge to waters of the United States. It states no numeric limits, monitoring schedules, discharge-occurrence conditions, or missing-data classifications. Purpose A requires enforceable numeric limits and measurement comparisons; Purpose B requires concrete monitoring requirements and their applicability conditions; Purpose C requires evidence about no-discharge periods, conditional monitoring, or other no-result states. None of those computations turn on alternative interpretations of this title line—the explicit 'DRAFT' label is descriptive rather than ambiguous, and operational questions about which permit terms govern Federal FY2025 depend on external permit-action history rather than contested reading of this clause.
